description.en: Sets the positions of the party members in one go: element i of the array is the position of party list entry i. The game keeps two lineups: the main formation (positions 1 to 11 for the players on the pitch) and a second lineup of 5 positions (probably the team for the small field matches). With true as second argument (only the value 1) the 5-position lineup is set instead of the main formation.
One position per party list entry, in list order.

examples.case: Both lineups after a recruitment (real usage, from ev42013800.nut; the arrays are written on fewer lines here)
